title: Trump-Backed Mike Lindell Loses Minnesota GOP Governor Primary to Lisa Demuth
detail: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth won the Republican gubernatorial primary on August 11, 2026, defeating Trump-endorsed MyPillow founder Mike Lindell and state-party-endorsed Kendall Qualls. Demuth becomes the first Black woman nominated for governor by a major party in Minnesota history and will face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in November. Lindell, who stepped down as MyPillow CEO to run, was hampered in the campaign's final weeks by questions from the state GOP chairman about his residency and by attacks from fellow Republicans, despite Trump's endorsement.

media.caption: Lisa Demuth wins the Minnesota GOP gubernatorial primary over Trump-endorsed Mike Lindell

title: Trump Declines to Rule Out Declaring National Security Emergency Over 2026 Midterm Elections
detail: In an August 11, 2026 interview with Real America's Voice host Wayne Allyn Root, Trump was asked whether he would declare a 'national security emergency for elections' to impose photo ID, proof-of-citizenship, and mail-ballot limits after the Senate failed to pass his SAVE America Act. Trump did not rule it out, responding 'stranger things have happened.' The remarks drew immediate criticism from Democrats and voting-rights groups warning of a constitutional crisis; the White House did not confirm any such action was imminent.

media.caption: Trump declines to rule out declaring a national security emergency over the 2026 midterm elections

title: Trump Directs CMS to End Medicaid Funding for Gender-Transition Care for Minors
detail: President Trump announced August 11, 2026 that Medicaid and CHIP will no longer fund gender-transition surgeries, puberty blockers, or cross-sex hormones for minors, directing CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz to implement the rule. The move follows an HHS review that Trump's team said found 'significant evidence gaps' and 'serious safety concerns' in the research supporting such care for children. Trump called the procedures 'barbaric surgeries' in his announcement; LGBTQ+ advocacy groups and pediatric medical associations condemned the decision as politically motivated and contrary to standard-of-care guidance from major medical organizations.

media.caption: Trump directs CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz to end Medicaid funding for gender-transition care for minors
